title: Deposit and Staged Payment Schedule by Programme
content:
# Deposit and Staged Payment Schedule by Programme

Under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions each programme fixes the share of the quoted total taken as a deposit before production begins, the share of that deposit that is never returned once the design has been approved, the shares of the quoted total collected at each stage, the number of calendar days before the promised delivery date by which the balance must be settled, whether the commission may be taken on a promotional financing plan, and whether an upgrade credit may be put toward it.

## Schedule

| Programme | Deposit (share of quoted total) | Non-refundable share of the deposit | Staged shares of the quoted total, in order | Balance due (calendar days before promised delivery) | Promotional financing admitted | Upgrade credit accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 30 per cent | 25 per cent | 30 per cent then 70 per cent | 3 | yes | yes |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 40 per cent | 35 per cent | 40 per cent then 60 per cent | 3 | yes | yes |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 50 per cent | 50 per cent | 50 per cent then 25 per cent then 25 per cent | 5 | yes | yes |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 50 per cent | 60 per cent | 50 per cent then 25 per cent then 25 per cent | 7 | yes | yes |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 50 per cent | 50 per cent | 50 per cent then 50 per cent | 5 | yes | yes |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 60 per cent | 75 per cent | 60 per cent then 20 per cent then 20 per cent | 10 | no | yes |

## Notes on the schedule

1. The staged shares are listed in the order the stages fall, and the first share listed is the deposit's share of the quoted total.
2. The non-refundable share is a share of the deposit, not of the quoted total.
3. Every programme accepts an upgrade credit; every programme admits promotional financing except the Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission.

## Worked hypothetical

A commission under Belrose Bespoke Design quoted at a hypothetical USD 10000.00: the deposit is 50 per cent of the quoted total, USD 5000.00; the non-refundable share of that deposit is 50 per cent of USD 5000.00, USD 2500.00; the staged shares are 50 per cent then 25 per cent then 25 per cent of the quoted total, USD 5000.00 then USD 2500.00 then USD 2500.00; and the balance falls due 5 calendar days before the promised delivery date.
